changelog: Tax Charge rules now detect specified tax codes in the Tax Paid table, without requiring the code to also appear in Tax Used; live status and rule descriptions updated.
Improved multi-line and wrapped tax parsing for Amadeus TWD/TQT and Galileo FHE displays, including two-column Amadeus screens and XT tax breakdowns.
Improved EQU/EQUIV one-way fare parsing and currency-prefix handling for PKR, CAD, and USD.
Whole amounts display without trailing .00 while genuine fractional decimals are preserved.
Added a 120 ms debounced real-time calculation engine for smoother UI responsiveness.
Added distinct row badges and left-stripes for Non-Refundable, Airline Non-Refundable, and Tax Charge rules.
Added focus window-guards for Amadeus TRFU and Galileo TRNE auto-entry, stopping typing if terminal focus shifts.
Improved greedy optimal matching for duplicate tax codes on Amadeus TRFT screens.
Updated the high-contrast dark workspace, added 30-level undo history with Ctrl+Z per tax table, and full report export/import state restoration.
